text.tspan: Covers US 2.0.9. No GPX upload exists in the code. All steps are Proposed. The flow copies the image upload
pattern: /api/s3/presign-homepage-images, a direct PUT to S3, then a database row (insertHomepageImageUpload).
Storage is not decided. This diagram shows the minimal option: the GPX file in S3 and one track row in the database.
[Not valid GPX or no track points]
The file is stored without change, so a read-back gives the same track points (AT4).
Open questions: where tracks are stored (S3 file or points in the database), the maximum file size,
and whether a Steward can also upload from inside a SIR.
Open question: if the delete of an invalid or unsaved file fails, the file stays in S3. AT 3 says nothing is saved.

svg.text: Choose a file and select Upload
Check the file extension and size
Show a refusal that names the size limit
POST siteId, file name, file size
getUser() and check approved account on server
Create a presigned PUT URL for a new key
Show "Upload failed, try again". Nothing is saved.
Check session. Take the user id from the session, not from the client.
Parse the GPX and count the track points (AT3)
Show "Not a valid GPX track". Nothing is saved.
Show the error. Nothing is saved.
Show "Track saved". The map can draw it (US 2.0.1 AT2).
US 2.0.9: Upload a GPX Track of a Site Visit
